statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-24137 is a path traversal in the legacy TUF client at pkg/tuf/client.go, which joins a cache base directory with an attacker-controllable target name from signed TUF metadata without validating that the result stays inside the base directory. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/sigstore code directly (sigstore is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not invoke the legacy TUF client, so the cache-write path is never executed.

CVE-2026-24117 is an SSRF in rekor's /api/v1/index/retrieve endpoint, which fetches a public key from a user-supplied URL. The vulnerable code is in rekor's server-side index retrieval handler. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/rekor code directly (rekor is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not run a rekor transparency log, so the index retrieve endpoint is never served.

CVE-2026-23831 is a nil pointer dereference in rekor's cose v0.0.1 entry Canonicalize() handler when validate() leaves sign1Msg uninitialized for an empty spec.message. The vulnerable code is in rekor's server-side proposed-entry processing. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/rekor code directly (rekor is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not run a rekor transparency log, so the cose entry handler is never invoked.

CVE-2026-22772 is an SSRF in the fulcio CA via an unanchored regex in pkg/config/config.go (function metaRegex), exploitable through a fulcio MetaIssuer URL when the CA processes a signing request. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/fulcio code directly (fulcio is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not run a fulcio CA, so the MetaIssuer parser is never invoked.

CVE-2026-22703 is a verification-bypass in cosign v2 where a crafted bundle can pass cosign verify even when the embedded Rekor entry does not reference the artifact. The vulnerable code lives in cosign's bundle-verification path invoked by cosign verify. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/cosign code directly (cosign is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa chain) and never invokes cosign verify, so the bypass code path is not executed.
